info.title: API.SH: Luma
info.description: The Luma API from API.SH: public Luma data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Luma calendar (an organiser's page): name, description, avatar, cover, website and social handles, location, verified flag, and its upcoming or past events (id, name, link, start and end, timezone, in person or online, place (address when public, city, region, country, coordinates), cover, free flag and price range, sold-out flag, spots left, approval needed, waitlist, guest count, calendar and hosts). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/luma-calendar

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Upcoming Luma events in a discover city or around a map point, optionally in one category. Each event: id, name, link, start and end, timezone, in person or online, place (address when public, city, region, country, coordinates), cover, free flag and price range, sold-out flag, spots left, approval needed, waitlist, guest count, calendar and hosts. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/luma-events

parameters.name: place
parameters.description: A discover city slug from /luma/v1/discover (e.g. sf, nyc, london, berlin, singapore) or its discplace- id.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category slug from /luma/v1/discover, e.g. ai, tech, arts, climate, fitness, wellness, crypto, food.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; null on the last page.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
